title: Joe Glaser takes over Louis Armstrong
summary: Charles recalls Glaser stopping at the Plantation with Armstrong in 1938 on his way back to New York.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Well, that was in '38. That was in '38 and that's when Joe Glaser took over Louis Armstrong.
Because they brought those girls that with him Armstrong had, through here? And they stopped at the Plantation Club. You know, He had a couple of girls with him?
Had a couple of girls with him, and they appeared -- they was at the Plantation for a couple of nights.
And Joe Glaser was taking them on back to New York then.
That's when he first picked up on Louis Armstrong.
That was one of the reasons, I think, and then that other that you didn't hear from him, in that this incident happened a little before then.
